postTitle: Is there a way to completly reset the entire game?
postSubject: like to get rid of every single thing like files and trophys.
commentSubject: Yes there is way in-game to reset everything. On the file-select screen (where to pick slot 1-3), hold down the END button your keyboard for 5 seconds. This will close the game, and erase the save file completely. Just restart the game!
